title: Doc-as-code gate (validate-agents-md) + check-count assertions + golden-fixtures for CAM_*_STATUS
description: Three parse/doc-safety items mapping to cam's own recurring lessons. (1) Doc-as-code gate (check:agents / validate-agents-md.ts): assert every 'cam <cmd>' / 'bun run <x>' and every backtick path cited in CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, and .claude/agents/* resolves to a real script/path, with a known-missing allowlist. Mechanically enforces the 2026-06-05 stale-comment lesson and the Doc-Maintenance rule. (2) check-count assertions: freeze the count of gates/oracles/health-checks so one silently disappearing fails a test, not just stays green (seeds doctor pass===12 pattern). (3) Golden-fixtures for the CAM_*_STATUS sentinel + handoff.json parsing: capture real worker-CLI output as test/.../__golden__/*.jsonl + a canonical form and diff in tests, so a silent upstream claude wire-shape change fails a test. Direct antidote to the recurring supervisor-sentinel-parse-fragility class (CAM-32/35). Source: seeds validate-agents-md.ts + doctor.test.ts; burrow src/runtime/parsers/__golden__/.

spec.scope: Add a doc-as-code CI gate that treats factual claims in the repo's own docs as machine-checkable assertions, plus one net-new registry count-freeze. Scanned surface: root CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, and .claude/agents/*.md (templates/** excluded: different resolution frame, already guarded by embed-vendor:check). Three reference classes are validated: cam <cmd> against the COMMANDS array (index.ts), bun run <x> against package.json scripts, and backtick path-claims against the filesystem. A structured inline known-missing allowlist exempts legitimately runtime-created artifacts. Wired as gate #12 in the check:all GATES manifest so it runs in CI. Item 2 (count-freeze) adds a COMMANDS count+membership freeze and updates the existing gate-count freeze 11->12. Golden-fixtures (original item 3) are split to a separate follow-up issue.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate-agents-md.ts exists and, when run, validates every `cam <cmd>` reference found in root CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, and .claude/agents/*.md against the COMMANDS array in index.ts; an unknown command name fails the gate (non-zero exit).
The same script validates every `bun run <x>` reference against package.json scripts keys; an unknown script name fails the gate.

The same script validates backtick path-claims against the filesystem. A backtick span is treated as a path-claim only if it contains '/' or ends in a known source extension (.ts .tsx .js .json .sh .md) AND contains no spaces, no '$', and no regex/shell metachars. A trailing :NNN or :NNN-NNN line-ref is stripped before resolving. Glob-ish spans (e.g. .claude/agents/*.md) resolve by >=1 filesystem match. A path-claim that neither resolves nor appears in the allowlist fails the gate. Spans failing the path-claim heuristic are ignored.

The script carries an inline KNOWN_MISSING allowlist of structured { pattern, reason } entries (glob-capable) exempting runtime-created artifacts (e.g. .claude/.cam-orch-ready, scripts/cam/prd.json, scripts/cam/worker-report.json, .claude/.cam-*.json markers, scripts/cam/journal.archive.md). Every entry has a non-empty reason.
The gate emits a non-fatal warning listing any KNOWN_MISSING allowlist entry that matched nothing during the run (guards against dead allowlist entries).
templates/** is excluded from the scanned surface.

A new gate #12 is added to the GATES manifest in scripts/check-all.ts, defined to spawn `bun scripts/validate-agents-md.ts` directly (same shape as sibling gates). A `check:agents` alias is added to package.json scripts. If check:ci-parity flags the new alias, check:agents is added to BUN_RUN_ALLOWLIST in the same change so check:ci-parity stays green.
The two existing gate-count freezes (test/gates-manifest.test.ts and test/check-all.test.ts) are updated from 11 to 12 and remain green, including any per-index/per-name assertions.
A test freezes the COMMANDS array (index.ts) exact count and exact membership (implementer verifies the live count; ~26 today). Adding or removing a command without updating the test fails it.

Unit tests for validate-agents-md.ts cover: valid cam cmd, invalid cam cmd, valid+invalid bun run, resolvable path, unresolved (failing) path, allowlisted-missing path, :NNN and :NNN-NNN line-ref stripping, glob match, and the unused-allowlist-entry warning.
check:all is green with all 12 gates; typecheck passes and the full bun test suite passes.
gotchas: COMMANDS is a runtime array (index.ts ~line 2373); removing an entry does NOT break typecheck (HELP_REGISTRY still typechecks with fewer keys), which is exactly why the count+membership freeze is needed. Verify the live count before hard-coding it.

check:ci-parity BUN_RUN_ALLOWLIST currently holds only { check:all, check:ci-parity } (scripts/check-ci-parity.ts ~line 29). Adding the check:agents package.json alias may require adding check:agents there to keep the gate green.

Do NOT scan templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md or any templates/** doc: their scripts/cam/... references resolve relative to a materialized target project, not this repo, and would produce false failures; template fidelity is already covered by embed-vendor:check.

.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md is by far the densest citer of paths/commands and will drive most real catches and most allowlist entries; expect a non-trivial KNOWN_MISSING population dominated by runtime artifacts it references.
Line-ref stripping must handle both single-line (index.ts:2373) and range (src/foo.ts:10-20) forms.
The existing closest analog, vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts, validates frontmatter shape only and is NOT run by check:all; do not conflate it with this gate.
